name: Credit memo processing
description: Route credit-memo requests through tiered approval, apply against oldest open invoices and post the GL entries.

name: Vendor spend analysis
description: Aggregate AP and card spend by vendor, surface maverick spending and flag contracts expiring within 90 days.

name: DSO monitor
description: Pull aging by customer segment from NetSuite weekly and escalate at-risk accounts to the right owners.

name: Deferred revenue schedule
description: Track prepaid balances across active contracts, release recognized revenue and auto-generate the monthly journal entries.

name: Dunning automation
description: Detect past-due Stripe invoices and send a multi-touch reminder sequence via SendGrid.

name: Customer lifetime value
description: Compute LTV by customer segment using historical revenue, churn and gross margin; push to Google Sheets quarterly.

name: Intercompany reconciliation
description: Reconcile intercompany balances across NetSuite subsidiaries, flag mismatches and stage elimination entries.

name: Collections performance
description: Track collector contact rates, promise-to-pay conversion and dollars recovered by rep weekly.

name: Tax compliance prep
description: Aggregate taxable transactions across entities each quarter, apply jurisdiction rules and stage filing-ready reports.

name: Payment method mix
description: Break revenue down by payment method, compute processing cost percentages and publish a monthly treasury summary.

name: Commission run
description: Pull Salesforce attainment, compute rep payouts against the comp plan and push approved payouts to Rippling.

name: Invoice aging analysis
description: Pull open invoices from NetSuite, group by aging bucket and ship a weekly summary to the controller in Slack.

name: Subscription MRR tracking
description: Pull subscription events from Stripe, classify MRR changes and push the trend to Google Sheets monthly.

name: Expense accrual automation
description: Estimate monthly expense accruals from open POs and recurring vendor contracts, post JEs and auto-reverse next period.

name: Revenue waterfall
description: Group Salesforce contracts by signing quarter, compute the recognized-revenue waterfall and sync to NetSuite.

name: Contract-to-invoice
description: Detect a signed contract, extract billing terms and create + send the matching invoice automatically.

name: Cash application
description: Match incoming Stripe and lockbox payments to open invoices and post matches to the GL automatically.

name: Duplicate payment detection
description: Scan pending and recently-cleared payments for duplicates by vendor, amount and invoice number; flag for AP review before they settle.

name: AR aging summary
description: Snapshot all open receivables across entities by aging bucket with drill-down by customer and segment.

name: MRR / ARR dashboard
description: Compute MRR and ARR each month from active Stripe subscriptions with new/expansion/contraction/churn breakdown.

name: Revenue recognition
description: Pull contract terms from DocuSign, compute monthly recognized revenue and post journal entries to QuickBooks.

name: Billing exceptions
description: Scan Stripe events daily for duplicate charges, pricing mismatches, failed renewals and unexpected plan changes.

name: Cash flow forecast
description: Project 13-week cash flow from open AR, scheduled AP, payroll and recurring revenue, and flag low-balance weeks.

name: Three-way PO match
description: Match purchase orders, goods receipts and vendor invoices automatically; route exceptions for approval.

name: Vendor payment scheduling
description: Pull approved bills from Bill.com, optimize timing to capture early-pay discounts and queue ACH batches in NetSuite.

name: Net revenue retention
description: Compute monthly NRR by cohort with expansion, contraction and churn — flag cohorts trending below 100%.

name: Payment reconciliation
description: Pull bank transactions from Plaid daily, match them against open invoices and bills in QuickBooks and surface discrepancies.

name: Revenue by product line
description: Join Salesforce line items with NetSuite recognized revenue and compute monthly margin by product/SKU.

name: Churn analysis
description: Decompose monthly churn by reason, contract value tier and segment; separate voluntary from involuntary.
